claims.claim: Assisted performance, unaided performance, delayed retention and transfer are distinct outcomes.
claims.verification: Official lab research overview retrieved, especially testing, fluency and desirable difficulties. Practical sequence is editorial synthesis.

claims.claim: Nearly 1000 Turkish high-school math students; GPT Base practice grades 48% above control, unaided exam grades 17% below control. Teacher-hint safeguards largely mitigated the penalty without a statistically significant positive exam effect.
claims.verification: Author PDF and publisher indexed text retrieved. Relative changes, not percentage points. No claim of permanent harm.

claims.claim: A separate structured college physics tutor improved immediate post-test performance compared with active classroom learning.
claims.verification: Publisher indexed abstract and results retrieved. Direct PDF request redirected to inaccessible cookie authorization. No claim of universal superiority or months-long retention.

claims.claim: Worked examples can help novices; unguided struggle is not a universal recommendation.
claims.verification: Publisher indexed full text retrieved. Randomized novice Year-7 algebra study; retention and near-transfer favored worked examples. No effect size narrated.

claims.claim: A practical demonstration: attempt with appropriate guidance, seek a hint, hide the answer, explain and check, vary the task and return later.
claims.source: Editorial synthesis based on the cited literature; not an independently validated universal intervention.
claims.verification: Illustrative equations checked: 2*4+3=11; (15-3)/2=6. Ada is fictional, not a reported study participant.
